title: Mercedes-Benz Van Wiper Clip
summary: A discontinued windshield-wiper retaining clip recreated at 1:1 scale for a Mercedes-Benz van.
imageAlt: Mercedes-Benz van wiper assembly and replicated black retaining clips
challenge: The original Mercedes-Benz van windshield-wiper retaining clip had been discontinued, leaving no direct replacement for the existing wiper assembly.
approach: The original clip geometry was recreated at full scale and refined for fit before the replacement was produced with FDM printing.
result: The finished replacement clip restored the original wiper assembly without requiring a complete replacement system.
